_comment: Phase 5.4 pinned expected SHA-256 for every Phase 5.4 mirror download. prepare_nerve_batch.ts compares staged bytes against this file and REJECTS on mismatch, so a swapped or re-converted mirror artifact cannot be ingested silently. These values are computed directly from the staged mirror bytes in C:/Projects/_audit_tmp/phase54_<FMA>.stl and cross-checked after staging against assets/raw/<asset_id>/ingestion.json original_hash. They attest the CONVERTED bytes served by the third-party OBJ-to-STL mirror, not DBCLS-original objects; the mirror is itself an unverified-conversion intermediary (see docs/PRODUCTION_DATASET_LICENSE_MATRIX.md).
provenance_authority: C:/Projects/_audit_tmp/phase54_<FMA>.stl staged bytes, recomputed after staging from assets/raw/<asset_id>/<FMA>.stl ingestion.json original_hash
residual_risk: MIRROR_CONVERSION_UNVERIFIED - the third-party mirror converts DBCLS OBJ to STL; these hashes pin WHICH converted bytes were ingested, not equivalence to a DBCLS-original release artifact. Comparison against an official DBCLS-published checksum is NOT AVAILABLE.
